WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-85.207185 34.992804)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-85.207185 34.992804)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'cycleway'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-85.207185 34.992804)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

WITH hotel_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-85.207185 34.992804)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
cycleways AS (
  SELECT 
    id, 
    geometry AS geom
  FROM 
    roads
  WHERE 
    cycleway IS NOT NULL
),
nearest_cycleway AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    ST_Distance(hotel_geom.geom, cycleways.geom) AS distance_m,
    cycleways.geom AS cycleway_geom
  FROM 
    cycleways, hotel_geom
  ORDER BY 
    hotel_geom.geom <-> cycleways.geom
  LIMIT 1
),
elevation_profile AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_3DInterpolatePoint(
      public.dem_us.rast, 
      ST_Transform(nearest_cycleway.cycleway_geom, 4326)::geometry
    ) AS elevation
  FROM 
    public.dem_us, nearest_cycleway
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, ST_Transform(nearest_cycleway.cycleway_geom, 4326)::geometry)
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(elevation) AS min_elev,
    MAX(elevation) AS max_elev,
    ST_Length(ST_Transform(nearest_cycleway.cycleway_geom, 3857)::geometry) AS length_m
  FROM 
    elevation_profile, nearest_cycleway
)
SELECT 
  'Chattanooga''s Budgetel' AS feature_name,
  nearest_cycleway.distance_m AS distance_to_cycleway,
  (elevation_stats.max_elev - elevation_stats.min_elev) / elevation_stats.length_m * 100 AS avg_grade_percent
FROM 
  nearest_cycleway, elevation_stats;
